description: A Solana wallet's open Jupiter orders: limit orders (Jupiter Trigger) with amount, limit price, how much has filled and expiry, and recurring DCA orders (Jupiter Recurring) with deposit, amount per cycle, interval, cycles done and left, and output received. Read-only: places no order and changes none. 10 of each per page. Fails (and is not charged) if Jupiter doesn't answer. Costs $0.001 USDC per call.
